scope: Peptides-func only; one frozen LCRC-C1 seed0 240-epoch run with Train-only per-label pos_weight weighted BCE

single_intervention.from: BCEWithLogitsLoss over 10 independent labels, elementwise mean
single_intervention.to: BCEWithLogitsLoss over 10 independent labels with per-label pos_weight, elementwise mean
single_intervention.pos_weight_constraints: no clipping, smoothing, square root, normalisation, rescaling or upper bound; values below 1 are retained
single_intervention.zero_positive_policy: stop and record an error; do not alter the formula
single_intervention.missing_label_policy: retain a finite-label mask; compute elementwise loss then average only valid entries; never flatten [batch, labels] before applying pos_weight

forbidden_changes: LCRC architecture, S1/S2, atom or bond features, readout
learning rate, weight decay, dropout, batch size, loss scaling
Focal Loss, Dice Loss or any other objective
a second configuration chosen from Validation results
reading Test data, Test labels or Test predictions

dataset.name: peptides-func
dataset.source: official PyG LRGBDataset Peptides-func fixed split
dataset.test_policy: terminal; no Test artifact is opened by any code path in this round

background_reference.role: fixed background reference from Diagnostic v1; not retrained and not a single-variable control

training.init: from scratch with the frozen Fast v1 seed0 initialisation mapping
training.batch_fallback_policy: only on CUDA OOM; record actual batch size and mark the run as no longer a strict single-variable control
training.loss: weighted BCE with Train-only per-label pos_weight
training.selection: maximum Validation mean average precision over 10 labels

resource_budget.smoke: one minimal CUDA engineering smoke is permitted; no additional formal training

test_isolation.audit_hook: sys.addaudithook on open(); forbidden historical Test artifact names raise TEST_ACCESS_BLOCKED
